definition.en: Development Financial Institutions (DFIs) are specialized financial entities established to provide long-term credit for capital-intensive projects that are crucial for national economic development.
definition.hi: Development Financial Institutions (DFIs) are specialized financial entities established to provide long-term credit for capital-intensive projects that are crucial for national economic development.

importanceInUpsc.en: DFIs are critical for UPSC GS-3 as they represent the government's strategy to bridge the infrastructure financing gap. Understanding their role in mobilizing capital for long-gestation projects is essential for answering questions on economic growth, investment models, and industrial policy.
